>Not enough natural resources for the whole nuh solar panels or muh wind power
I don't think that it would be impossible if humanity manages to salvage (i.e, not produce from other resources) a couple of solar panels as a starting point to resurrect an industrial society. They wouldn't be able to power a lot, of course, but I think humans are an industrious sort and even a little power might lead back to a green energy focused industrial future after a collapse. That might make the return to a (highly altered version) of an industrial society even faster than what we had to go through blindly with our own technological progresses.
